name: meterapp-meter
description: Plugins by Meter, the taxi meter and fleet platform: Meter for Drivers & Fleets and Meter Rides, one plugin per hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: meter-fleet
plugins.description: See your fleet's trips, bookings, drivers, vehicles, earnings and accounting, or a driver's own trips and pay, and change settings with a preview and your confirmation. Five skills plus the hosted Meter for Drivers & Fleets server; sign in with your Meter account.

plugins.name: meter-rides
plugins.description: Book, follow and cancel your own taxi rides with a price preview and your confirmation, paid on Meter's checkout page, never in the chat. Two skills plus the hosted Meter Rides server; sign in with your Meter account.
